page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, indicating that hyperthreading is disabled. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include any bundled local SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it offers zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A key technical characteristic of this instance is the absence of advanced CPU instruction sets and hardware acceleration features. The processor configuration lacks support for Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and cryptographic acceleration instructions such as AES and SHA_NI. Furthermore, virtualization extensions (VMX, SVM) and hyperthreading are unavailable. Because there is no local storage, all storage requirements must be met using network-attached block storage.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.2xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require a larger memory footprint relative to processing power. By providing 16.0 GB of RAM with only 2 dedicated vCPUs, it allows deployments to avoid the cost of scaling up vCPU counts solely to acquire sufficient memory. This profile is suitable for memory-intensive, low-compute workloads such as small-scale databases, in-memory caching layers, lightweight enterprise applications, and basic web serving where dedicated CPU allocation is preferred over shared resources.
